name: splitease
description: Split shared expenses — one React Native (Expo) codebase for iOS, Android & web, GraphQL Yoga + Pothos + Prisma API

paragraphs: SplitEase is a Splitwise-style app for shared costs: trips, flats, office lunches. One React Native codebase runs on iOS, Android and the web, backed by a code-first GraphQL API. It covers four split modes (equal, exact, percentage, shares), debt simplification, multi-currency groups, realtime updates and an offline-friendly cache.
Live demo — click “Try the demo”. You get a private sandbox with sample groups, no sign-up needed.
More in docs/screenshots/ (dark mode, welcome page, expense list).
features: One codebase, three platforms. Expo SDK 57, Expo Router and Tamagui. On wide screens (desktop web, tablets) the app shows a sidebar; on phones it uses bottom tabs. Haptics on native, dark mode everywhere.

GraphQL done properly. GraphQL Yoga with Pothos (code-first, Prisma plugin, Relay connections, scope auth). Typed client documents come from GraphQL Code Generator, and urql uses Graphcache for a normalised cache.

Money is never a float. Every amount is an integer in minor units (paise, cents). Rounding remainders are assigned with the largest-remainder method, so splits always add up to the exact total. The same split code runs…
Debt simplification. A greedy net-balance algorithm turns a web of IOUs into at most n − 1 payments, e.g. “Rahul pays you ₹6,456.83”. Property-based tests check that money is conserved.

Production-minded auth. Argon2id password hashing and 15-minute JWT access tokens. Refresh tokens are opaque, stored only as an HMAC, rotated on every use, and reuse of an old token revokes the whole token family.…
